name: agentic-coding-harness
description: Run, watch, and meter coding agents — Claude Code, OpenCode, Kiro, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI — with normalized events, cost accounting, and replayable run artifacts.
author: Stephen Blatt

scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:bun && npm run build:lib
scripts.build:node: rm -rf dist/cli && bun build src/cli/ach.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --external bun-pty --banner "#!/usr/bin/env node" && cp src/web/index.html src/web/grid.html src/web/trio.html src/web/term-pane.html src/web/feed.js dist/cli/ && cp -R src/web/vendor dist/cli/vendor
scripts.build:bun: bun build src/cli/ach.ts --outdir dist/bun --target bun --banner "#!/usr/bin/env bun"
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --external bun-pty
